description: The cached decoded vocabulary is mutated by separately cached ordinary-list calls, duplicating appended vocabulary entries during construction.
trigger: A tokenizer has actual_vocab_size greater than raw_vocab_size. Construction calls get_id_to_piece_list(True), which invokes the no-argument form, then calls get_id_to_piece_list(False).
expected_behavior: Each appended ID occupies exactly one table position, and the reverse map points to that ID.
actual_behavior: Both ordinary computations obtain the same get_fixed_vocab list and append the extension again. The special copy predates the second append; the reverse dictionary enumerates the duplicated list and can map an extended piece to its later, incorrect index.

verification.description: Modeled constructor call order, lru_cache argument distinctions, cached-list aliasing and extension.
verification.limits: Synthetic two-token vocabulary with one extension; no tokenizer backend executed.

introductions.rationale: Introduced by243; independently confirmed in its verdict.
